logicalSteps.logicalNarrative: User requests enter through the global External Application Load Balancer. Cloud Armor mitigates DDoS/OWASP threats, strips untrusted client-supplied `X-Tenant-ID` headers (`<0.15 ms`), and invokes edge prompt screening.

logicalSteps.zone: Yellow & Red Zones (Hops 5a & 3b Data, Tools & Reasoning)
